notes.title: Lost in the woods? Humans got you confused?
notes.content:
The Grey Man is not for the impatient gamer, it's definitely riding on that classic "figure it out" retro game appeal of generations long forgotten. 

If you find yourself having a hard time wrapping your mind around the flow of the experience, we offer you some guidance in the form of a "First 12 Minutes" playthrough video.

This should not only act as a more straightforward gameplay guide but also might allow you to repeat many of the more advanced moves utilized by a veteran player.

https://youtu.be/ufD_jtEUSUA

We hope you enjoy and continue to get weird in the woods with us!

-ATKMTN

notes.title: THE GREY MAN v1.01 HAS LANDED
notes.content:
[b]Okay dude,[/b] it's time for the 30 day patch that your mother has been wondering about and your father already loves.

This update features some minor changes, mostly centered around player communication. We've made it more clear how our human gates work, and also fixed a pretty rare location saving problem that basically teleported the Grey Man around like a real wild animal across full screens, confusing everyone. 

[i]Patch notes below:[/i]

[b]THE GREY MAN - v1.01 PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]GAME[/b]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a rare bug wherein using the UFO's Fast Travel ability towards the end of the game would cause the Grey Man to appear at the wrong sides of the screen while traveling between certain areas.
    [*] Fixed a bug that was causing the game to trigger a fade out transition when the player approached right-side exits, even if they didn't capture enough humans to advance to the next area.
    [*] One human's behavior has been altered.
[/list]
[b]SYSTEM[/b]
[list]
    [*] Improved messaging for when the user tries to enter an area without having captured the proper amount of humans. Made the 'Humans Required' pop-out display larger so it's easier to read, in addition to adding an error sound.
[/list]
Thanks for playing folks, [i]we'll be here all weekend![/i]

-ATKMTN

notes.title: THE GREY MAN featured in PC Gamer's "Five new Steam games you probably missed this week"!
notes.content:
The keen eyes over at [b]PC Gamer[/b] have spotted the Grey Man wandering the wilds of the internet and felt the urge to share it with the world.

Each week they're choosing five new Steam games that might be flying under your radar but are too interesting to miss out on, and [b]THE GREY MAN[/b] has made the list. [i]Don't you just love it?[/i]

[quote=PC Gamer]"The Grey Man is a sidescrolling adventure game where you play an inter-dimensional alien visiting the campsite of a national park. You can wander around the open world and interact with the people there, but it's not entirely clear what the actual progression of the game is. [i]I imagine finding that out is part of the experience, but the few Steam reviews it's received so far speak highly of the casual experience of discovering The Grey Man's pixely world.[/i]"[/quote]

Check out their write up here; http://www.pcgamer.com/new-steam-games

Don't forget to check out [b]THE GREY MAN[/b] for yourself and let us know what you think folks. It's a big mysterious world out there just waiting for you to explore!

-ATKMTN
